**Play in the browser:** https://zahikusa.github.io/mythwar/ (single player on any device; installable as an app).

**Multiplayer in your Wi-Fi:** download **mythwar-server-….zip** below on one computer (Windows, macOS or Linux), unzip it and start it:

- **Windows:** double-click `Start Mythwar Server`. It offers to install Node.js if needed. If Windows warns about the file, choose *More info → Run anyway*. When the firewall asks, allow **private** networks.
- **macOS:** right-click `Start Mythwar Server.command` → *Open* (only the first time).
- **Linux:** `sh start.sh`

It shows an address and a QR code: scan it with every phone (or open the address in any browser in the same Wi-Fi), then **Multiplayer → Host a battle**. Needs Node.js 20 or newer.
